## The Crème School Offers Military Families Complimentary Child Care Discovery Day During Military Family Appreciation Month


11/02/2026


Download (opens in new window)


*Military families can experience The Crème School's elevated early childhood education learning model through a complimentary day of care*


**Key takeaways**


- **Free child care day for military families:** The Crème School is offering military families a complimentary day of child care at participating schools nationwide through Dec. 31, 2026.
- **Supporting military families:** Frequent relocations and deployments can make finding consistent, high-quality child care challenging for military families.
- **Early childhood education and enrichment:** The Crème School offers research-based early childhood education with enrichment in STEM, Spanish, music and art.


LAKE OSWEGO, Ore.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[The Crème School](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcremedelacreme.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3Dcdlc-lg%26utm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_content%3Dmil&esheet=54632068&newsitemid=20261102964007&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Cr%26egrave%3Bme+School&index=1&md5=001c37407e76eea1d35a4b7300c50e20) , a premium provider of early childhood education and care, is celebrating Military Family Appreciation Month by inviting military families to experience a complimentary Military Discovery Day at participating schools nationwide. Available now through Dec. 31, 2026, the offer gives children from infants through school-age an opportunity to explore The Crème School's elevated learning experience.


“Military families often face unique challenges, from frequent relocations and deployments to building new support systems in unfamiliar communities far from loved ones,” said Stephanie Sturdevant-Ward, vice president of The Crème School. “We want to help ease those transitions by becoming part of their village, offering a warm, welcoming school community where children feel a sense of belonging, discover their passions and thrive. Through our complimentary Discovery Day, we’re proud to invite military families to experience firsthand the exceptional education, enriching experiences and meaningful connections that make The Crème School so special.”


Through[The Crème Learning Approach™](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcremedelacreme.com%2Feducation%2F%3Futm_campaign%3Dcdlc-lg%26utm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_content%3Dmil&esheet=54632068&newsitemid=20261102964007&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Cr%26egrave%3Bme+Learning+Approach%26%238482%3B&index=2&md5=659b874308ef9a951ba5d45fb3fc02b2) , children experience a comprehensive, research-based curriculum that combines early academics with creativity, exploration and hands-on discovery. Beginning in early preschool, children participate in daily 30-minute rotations through signature enrichment classes in STEM, Spanish, Music and Art. This distinctive model introduces children to new concepts and experiences throughout the day while fostering independence, problem-solving skills and a lifelong love of learning.


Military families interested in scheduling a complimentary Discovery Day from now through Dec. 31, 2026, can visit[CremedelaCreme.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcremedelacreme.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3Dcdlc-lg%26utm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_content%3Dmil&esheet=54632068&newsitemid=20261102964007&lan=en-US&anchor=CremedelaCreme.com&index=3&md5=ce5501e081f4322eddfb78cc11406ab1) **** to find a nearby participating school and learn more about availability,[fee-assistance qualifications](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcremedelacreme.com%2Ftuition-support%2F%3Futm_campaign%3Dcdlc-lg%26utm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_content%3Dmil&esheet=54632068&newsitemid=20261102964007&lan=en-US&anchor=fee-assistance+qualifications&index=4&md5=21187a52fd1f9272e4a08fbfc1838afb) and eligibility.


**About The Crème™ School**


The Crème™ School (NYSE: KLC) offers an unparalleled, boutique early learning experience for children, from infants through kindergarten. Through The Crème Learning Approach™, vibrant classrooms, talented educators, enriching curriculum, and exceptional amenities come together to build the skills and confidence children need for what’s next. For more information, visit[CremedelaCreme.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcremedelacreme.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3Dcdlc-lg%26utm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpr%26utm_content%3Dmil&esheet=54632068&newsitemid=20261102964007&lan=en-US&anchor=CremedelaCreme.com&index=5&md5=507565f4f2830671e2cac647bfb7ae78) .
